subject.title: Bug: tools.deny does not hide skill_workshop from Codex deferred tools

question: Should maintainers require live Codex app-server proof before closing this security-relevant tool-policy report, or is current-main source-path proof enough to close it as not reproduced?
rationale: The shared source path now appears correct, but the reported failure is a policy visibility boundary in a live Codex session and the issue already carries maintainer/security/live-repro review signals.

options.title: Keep for live security proof
options.body: Require a live current-main Codex app-server capture or equivalent Crabbox proof before closing or dispatching a fix.

options.title: Close as not reproduced
options.body: Accept the current source-path check and later comment as sufficient proof that the shared path no longer leaks `skill_workshop`.

options.title: Sponsor a focused regression PR
options.body: Have a maintainer adopt a narrow test-only or source-proof PR that locks the denied Skill Workshop dynamic-tool and prompt behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep for live security proof
recommendation.body: Require a live current-main Codex app-server capture or equivalent Crabbox proof before closing or dispatching a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex app-server and Skill Workshop history makes this the strongest available owner for the security/proof decision.
